change_motivation_frozen_before_v2_resul: The preregistered v1 stratified sampler already oversampled foreground and boundary pixels; applying a second inverse-frequency positive weight reduced sampled loss but regressed full-image IoU. V2 uses uniform pixels and uniform BCE so the optimized empirical risk matches the full-image measure.
membership_model: one continuous probability in [0,1] per frozen RGB Gaussian and query
observation_operator: exact frozen front-to-back contribution, alpha-conditioned scalar membership

optimization.loss: uniform probability BCE plus 0.5 soft Dice

result_interpretation: Report the best constructed feasible membership as a lower bound on the true optimum. An optimizer regression cannot lower that bound and cannot establish a carrier hard limit.
